# vendor

Package tarballs the site installs with a `file:` dependency, until they are published on the npm registry. Never edit a tarball: replace it with a new build and update this list and the dependency that names it.

| File | Package | Built from | sha256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `komugi-ai-engine-0.1.0-6d27b166.tgz` | `@komugi-ai/engine` 0.1.0 (MIT), used by `apps/web` | Komugi commit `6d27b166e071f181914bb0421cb904adf5ce5c51` | `7f9368a31bb3f95259b7ba201024102da7beb55f2a02d9769ec268ad0a10d5bd` |

To check a tarball: `sha256sum vendor/<file>`.
